integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 116 file changes, 17 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: The more faithful visual reproduction, with authentic branding, date grouping and URL routing. Slightly less product depth and a much smaller seeded mailbox than its sibling.

standards.summary: 9,289 lines across 27 files with a hand-rolled router, a shortcuts module and a media-query layer, all cleanly separated. Untested, like its sibling.

findings.title: No automated tests
findings.detail: search.ts, shortcuts.ts and the store reducers are all pure and directly testable, and none has coverage. The search tokeniser in particular has enough branches to warrant it.

strengths: router.ts gives each mailbox a real URL rather than component state
shortcuts.ts centralises the key map instead of scattering handlers
contacts.ts and media.ts keep recipient and attachment concerns out of components
66 ARIA attributes and 22 keyboard-handling sites, the best of the two

specification.summary: All essential outcomes are met. The seeded mailbox is a third the size of the sibling's, which thins out search and label exploration.

findings.title: Seeded mailbox is small for the brief's intent
findings.detail: 16 threads in the inbox against the sibling's 48. The brief asks for a realistic seeded mailbox that rewards exploration, and at this volume search, bulk actions and label filtering have little to work on. Widen the corpus.

strengths: Inbox, Starred, Sent, Drafts and Trash all navigable with real URLs
Compose, send, draft, star, archive, delete and label all functional
Category tabs with live unread counts
Search filters against subject, sender and body

ux.summary: The most convincing Gmail impersonation of the two: authentic mark, correct label palette, and date-grouped threads that make the list immediately scannable.

findings.title: No visible storage meter or label counts in the sidebar
findings.detail: The sidebar shows label colours but no per-label counts beyond a few, and the storage bar has no manage link. Small fidelity gaps against the reference the sibling run covers.

strengths: Date group headers: TODAY / YESTERDAY / LAST 7 DAYS / LAST 30 DAYS
Authentic multicolour brand mark and label palette
Importance markers and attachment indicators in the row
Message copy reads like real correspondence rather than lorem
